name: FinnyShare
overview: Remote access for Jellyfin behind CGNAT - no port forwarding, no static IP
description: Get a public HTTPS address for this server, even behind CGNAT or a router you cannot configure. The plugin keeps one outbound tunnel to a FinnyShare relay and proxies remote requests to Jellyfin; your logins and permissions are unchanged. BETA: capped at 10 Mbps per server (shared by all remote viewers, unlimited viewers), single relay, no uptime guarantee.
